Every job in the index plays full screen as you point at it, with the crew set out as end credits

name: Long Exposure
short: A showreel website that plays your best work first and turns viewers into booked shoots.
long: Long Exposure's reel fills the first screen with a running timecode, and the scrub bar is made of the four jobs: tap one and the reel cuts to it. Below, the work index plays each job full screen as you point at it, and the call sheet request starts with the six things they shoot.
proves: A film company's site can open on the film, and still take the enquiry.
story: Film companies tend to bury the reel behind a play button on a black page. This one opens on it, keeps the timecode honest, and lets you scrub straight to the job you care about.
